about_the_game:
Galactic Gardener is a short-session roguelite about growing your own firepower. You pilot an autonomous terraforming drone left behind on a dead world, fighting back a mutation outbreak with weaponized plants.

Each run unfolds on a compact garden of planters, each holding up to six evolving plants. Between waves, you graft, link, and rearrange flora to forge deadly synergies — roots link shields, spores chain explosions, vines feed pulse cannons. Every placement matters, and every plant can turn against you.

  • Grow your arsenal across a 2x3 grid of reactive ecosystems.

  • Survive escalating waves of alien flora gone rogue.

  • Stack links and mods that twist your build in unpredictable ways.

  • Experiment with card-based upgrades that redefine your entire strategy each run.

  • Chill yet chaotic tone — fast tactical gameplay wrapped in cozy bioluminescent visuals.

Humanity may have left, but your directive remains: Cultivate for their return.
The question is — what will still be alive when they do?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7020U / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 620 / NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 250
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Playable at 720p / 30 FPS on integrated graphics.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p / 60 FPS or higher. SSD recommended.
